title: Proclus' scholia (and Byzantine scholia) on Hesiod's Works and Days / Схолии Прокла к «Трудам и дням» Гесиода
author: Proclus Diadochus, with Tzetzes and Moschopoulos layers
size: Pertusi 1955: est. ~300 pp. Proclus layer: est. ~40k words.
edition: Pertusi 1955 (Vita e Pensiero, in copyright). Gaisford, Poetae Minores Graeci, is PD.
ru_evidence: Ancientrome.ru Hesiod page lists only the poems (Veresaev, Tsybenko). No Russian translation of the scholia found.
en_evidence: None found; exhaustive search was not possible. BMCR 2014.12.27 names only an Italian translation of the Hesiod scholia.
other_translations: Italian: Cassanmagnago 2009, all Hesiod scholia (Bompiani; per BMCR 2014). German: Marzillo 2010, Proclus' fragments (from bibliographic knowledge, not re-verified).
value: A Neoplatonist's ethical and allegorical reading of Hesiod. Preserves Plutarch's lost Works and Days commentary and agrarian and calendar lore. Valuable for philosophers and for the reception of Hesiod.
ai_feasibility: High-medium. Clear expository prose; separating the Proclan, Plutarchan and Byzantine layers needs an expert.
pilot_unit: Prolegomena plus scholia on Works and Days 1–201 (Prometheus, Pandora, Ages); est. ~12k words.
